entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: A young human woman, leader of the Neurok humans of Medev on Mirrodin, who could use blue and black mana.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: An elf ally of Bruenna whose spark Memnarch sought to steal.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Goblin artificer who relinquished his spark, triggering the Vanishing.

entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: A golem who traveled with Glissa and Slobad.

entities.name: Lord Pontifex
entities.description: Vedalken who murdered Bruenna's father Donal and later captured her.

entities.name: Donal
entities.description: Bruenna's father, murdered by Vedalken researchers.

entities.name: Janus
entities.description: Synod member who worked to usurp Memnarch.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The mad overseer of Mirrodin who sought to steal Glissa's spark.

entities.name: Lyese
entities.description: Glissa's estranged sister who joined Bruenna.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Undead lord of the Mephidross whom Bruenna sought as an ally.

entities.name: Yert
entities.description: Deranged vampire working for Memnarch who captured Bruenna.

entities.name: Dwugget
entities.description: Goblin who fought beside Bruenna at Krark-Home.

entities.name: Raksha
entities.description: Restored to another world alongside Bruenna.

entities.name: Ushanti
entities.description: Restored to another world alongside Bruenna.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: Humans of Mirrodin led by Bruenna.

entities.name: Synod
entities.description: Vedalken ruling body of the blue-aligned regions.

entities.name: Medev
entities.description: Neurok village overrun by Memnarch's levelers.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial plane where Bruenna lived.

entities.name: Krark-Home
entities.description: Site of the final siege.

entities.name: Lume
entities.description: City Bruenna helped build in her new life.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: Event triggered when Slobad relinquished his spark, recovering the dead souls.

entities.name: Fifth Dawn
entities.description: Event after which a green sun erupted in Mirrodin's core.

events.summary: Bruenna's father Donal is murdered by Vedalken researchers led by Lord Pontifex.
events.quote: Her father Donal was murdered by Vedalken researchers led by Lord Pontifex

events.summary: Bruenna agrees to help Glissa, Slobad and Bosh reach the Pool of Knowledge.
events.quote: she agreed to assist them, motivated by the opportunity to undermine the Vedalken

events.summary: Bruenna and Glissa are captured by Lord Pontifex, escape, and survive a confrontation with Janus.
events.quote: She was later captured with Glissa by Lord Pontifex

events.summary: Memnarch's levelers overrun Medev, killing all its inhabitants; Bruenna barely escapes.
events.quote: She barely escaped alive, but Medev and all its inhabitants were lost.

events.summary: Bruenna unites the races of Mirrodin with Glissa and Lyese against Memnarch.
events.quote: Bruenna was instrumental in bridging alliances between elves, leonin, goblins, and others.

events.summary: Bruenna is captured by Yert in the Mephidross and hooked into a stasis machine; Glissa frees her but is locked in stasis for five years.
events.quote: There she was captured by Yert

events.summary: Bruenna loses a hand in the war and later frees Glissa from stasis.
events.quote: Bruenna lost a hand during the war with Memnarch

events.summary: Bruenna fights beside Lyese and Dwugget in the final siege of Krark-Home and dies when Mirrodin's life is extinguished.
events.quote: Bruenna, like everyone else on the plane, died instantly.

events.summary: Slobad relinquishes his spark, triggering the Vanishing and recovering the souls.
events.quote: those souls were recovered when Slobad relinquished his fresh spark

events.summary: Bruenna is restored on another world without memories and helps build Lume and negotiate a peace treaty.
events.quote: There, she helped build the city of Lume and negotiate a peace treaty

relations.note: Leader of the Neurok humans of Medev.
relations.quote: Bruenna was the leader of the Neurok humans of Medev
